name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
steps: Stand with feet just wider than your hips and hold the kettlebell by its horns against your chest.
Tuck your elbows down toward your ribs, brace your core, and sit your hips down between your knees while keeping your chest tall.
Lower as far as you can while keeping your feet planted and your back braced.
Drive through your whole feet to extend your hips and knees back to standing.
tips: Keep your heels grounded flat on the floor and your chest facing forward rather than tipping over.
Hold the kettlebell snug against your sternum instead of letting it drift forward away from your chest.
